IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Paging: multiple errors observed in streaming/function-call flows (SSE disconnects + tool-call parse errors). Triggering alert group. Please ack if on-call. thread_ts=1768501234
Alex (on-call): acked. I'm on it. Starting triage — bringing logs and timeline.
Priya G: onstandby, can help with customer impact assessment and comms. Which customers are affected?
Alex (on-call): early indicators: increased disconnects hitting streaming endpoints (sse/v1/stream) and a bunch of 400s from the tool-call parser. I see repeated json parse failures in the connector service.
Miguel R: adding logs I pulled from connector-frontend (pod connector-54f2):
```
2026-03-10T14:35:12Z ERROR parser request_id=tr-9a3f service=connector msg="json parse error" error=\"Unexpected token '}' at position 234\" payload=\"{\"tool_call\": {\"name\": \"search\", \"args\": \"{\\\"q\\\":\\\"foo\\\"}}\"\n```
Alex (on-call): interesting — args is double-encoded string rather than JSON object. Could be a client SDK change.
Zoe SRE: I see a spike in SSE 410/connection-closed around the same time on the runtime nodes (runtime-gpu-*) correlated with increased parse errors. Probably clients aborting when they get unexpected tool responses.
Priya G: Customer Support: initial triage shows 3 customers with active sessions experiencing truncated responses (no tokens after 3-5s). I've flagged them as impacted: cust-ambassador, cust-payflow, cust-docs. Customer-facing incident page is open.
Miguel R: grabbing trace IDs for one session: tr-9a3f, tr-9a41, tr-9a9c. Pasting a full request/response sample (sanitized):
```
REQUEST: {"model":"x-large","input":"...","tool_call":{"name":"search","args":"{\"q\":\"user query\"}"}}
RUNTIME RESPONSE STREAM (partial): event: tool_call
data: {"name":"search","args":"{\"q\":\"user query\"}"}
ERROR: runtime-parser: failed to parse args as JSON, closing stream
```
Alex (on-call): hypothesis 1: client SDK started sending args as escaped string; runtime expects object and fails to parse -> triggers parse error -> runtime closes SSE. Hypothesis 2: a change in our tool-call serializer introduced double-escaping in a recent release (eng-runtime).
Zoe SRE: can we confirm code deploys around 14:30 UTC? Deploy bot logs show a small patch to tool-call serialization landed at 14:27 by @devsquad.
Miguel R: I pulled git diff from that revision: they wrapped args with `json.dumps(args)` in one additional layer. Looks like a regression.
Alex (on-call): mitigation: rollback the patch on runtime to stop immediate customer impact. I'm starting a rollback canary to 2 nodes. 
Priya G: comms: telling the three impacted customers we're investigating and applying mitigation; ETA ~15min. Escalation to enterprise CS for cust-payflow since they have high RPO.
IncidentBot: Deploy rollback started for runtime-service at 2026-03-10T14:48:02Z by Alex (on-call). Canary on 2 pods.
Zoe SRE: rollback canary shows steady streams restored on those pods, no parse errors in logs after 14:52. Metrics: SSE disconnect rate back to baseline on canary nodes.
Miguel R: confirming: removed the extra json.dumps in runtime serializer and deployed. Will push a full rollback to all nodes after validation.
Alex (on-call): rolling to 4 more nodes now. Keeping one node in bad-state to continue capturing traces for root cause.
Priya G: updated customers: cust-ambassador and cust-docs have recovered. cust-payflow still seeing intermittent issues — CS escalation in progress.
Customer Support: noted, on escalation path with cust-payflow POC, sharing temporary workaround: set `tool_call_args_as_string=true` in SDK v0.9.4 to avoid failures.
Miguel R: hypothesis tracking in-thread:
- H1: runtime regression (extra-encoding) — evidence: deploy diff + logs.
- H2: client SDK change co-occurring — evidence: none yet; no customer SDK version widespread.
- H3: downstream proxy mutating payloads — low likelihood, no proxy logs show mutation.
Alex (on-call): next steps: 1) full rollback to all runtime nodes (in progress), 2) create patch PR to add defensive parsing (accept both string and object) + unit tests, 3) add schema validation alert, 4) postmortem skeleton.
Zoe SRE: noted. I'll keep one canary cluster on the old code for 2h for log sampling. Will also add an SLO rollback check.
IncidentBot: Severity reduced to P2 at 2026-03-10T15:12:49Z — customer impact contained, mitigation in progress.
Priya G: I'm drafting the in-incident RCA timeline and will post a timeline snippet here for review.
Alex (on-call): handoff to night on-call (Miguel) in 20 minutes. Summaries: root cause likely runtime serializer regression, rollback applied, customers partly recovered, follow-ups: SDK advisory, patch PR, postmortem.
Miguel R: taking over on-call. I'll finish the rollout and open the PR for defensive parsing. Also will coordinate with SDK team to confirm no client changes.
Priya G: timeline draft (for RCA):
- 14:27 UTC: runtime patch deployed -> changed serializer
- 14:35 UTC: first parse errors observed (tr-9a3f)
- 14:40 UTC: alert fires for SSE disconnect spike
- 14:48 UTC: rollback canary started
- 14:52 UTC: canary nodes show recovered streams
- 15:05 UTC: rollback in progress to majority of nodes
- 15:12 UTC: severity lowered to P2
- 15:40 UTC: handoff to Miguel (on-call)
Priya G: tagging follow-ups for postmortem: assign owner for PR (Miguel), SDK compatibility check (SDK lead), customer follow-up notes (CS lead).
Alex (on-call): leaving notes in the incident doc. Thanks all. Miguel, ping me if you want a quick sync during handoff.
Miguel R: will do. Added a note to include the failing trace IDs and the one remaining bad node logs in the postmortem.
IncidentBot: Incident thread will be archived when postmortem is published.
